mechanic_assessment_summary.criterion: Controlled pre-dodge possession, backward or back-diagonal dodge release, dodge-proximate human contact, and meaningful ball momentum transfer.

outcome_grouping.policy: Relative descriptive triage only. Buckets are not mechanic detectors, success labels, rewards, or training targets; all attempts remain preserved.

paired_stream_assessment.interpretation: Global engine physics-frame identifiers may jump across native lifecycle resets. No missing action tick is synthesized. Each such jump is a hard segment boundary.
paired_stream_assessment.unpaired_tail_policy: Events and markers outside the first-to-last captured action frame are retained as metadata but excluded from attempt anchors, boundaries, and paired telemetry.

segmentation_audit.policy: Local-human native jump-onset activity anchors are grouped only within a continuous paired state/action region. Native reset, respawn, local-car rebind, and global physics-frame discontinuities are hard boundaries. Sustained two-wheel grounded recovery separates attempts. The declared mechanic does not change segmentation.
segmentation_audit.unsegmented_policy: No synthetic attempt is created when no native jump onset exists.
